title: Billing
personal: Plans belong to an organization. Switch to one from the menu at the top of the sidebar.
readOnly: Only owners and admins can change the plan.

notices.success: Payment received. Your new plan shows here as soon as Paymob confirms it.

taglines.PRO: For a person or a small team.
